title: DEV-HARNESS-01 — Harness-Neutral Agent Operations Contract
purpose: Define the read-only normalization boundary between external coding-agent harnesses and Locaily's development control plane.
problem: Locaily has durable lifecycle, session, handoff, validation, memory, and operator surfaces, but no canonical snapshot contract for comparing Codex, OpenCode, and future harness evidence.

included: Canonical harness-neutral agent operations snapshot contract
Read-only Codex and OpenCode fixture adapters
Normalization of workers, worktrees, objectives, handoffs, checks, and lifecycle state
Explicit HUD fields for context pressure, tool activity, risk, cost, and synchronization
Evidence availability, unsupported evidence, and redaction semantics
Links to Locaily milestones, development sessions, work closeouts, validation records, and reviewed memory candidates
Deterministic local fixtures, adapter tests, and a read-only operator status surface
excluded: Harness hooks or automatic transcript capture
Mutating harness control, command dispatch, or session management
Playbook promotion or automatic workflow generation
Cloud fallback or network-dependent evidence collection

acceptanceCriteria.description: A strict canonical snapshot schema represents harness identity, workers, worktrees, objectives, handoffs, checks, lifecycle state, HUD state, provenance, and evidence availability.
Codex and OpenCode fixture adapters produce equivalent canonical shapes while preserving harness-specific provenance.
Unavailable or unsupported harness evidence is explicit and redacted fields never become inferred facts.
The snapshot links read-only to current Locaily milestone, session, closeout, validation, and reviewed-memory records without mutating them.
A local read-only status command and operator endpoint expose the normalized snapshot and its evidence limits.
Focused adapter tests, schema fixtures, and relevant offline Locaily validation commands pass.
